dedupe_keys.name: global omnium water network digital twin valencia xylem vue

description: This white paper page from Xylem describes the digital twin run by Global Omnium, the water utility of Valencia in Spain, which replicates a system serving 1.7 million residents. The twin covers two treatment plants, 28 storage tanks, 47 pumps and 219 operating valves and takes in more than 20,000 readings a day, using Xylem Vue's real-time what-if scenarios application on a hydraulic model with errors below 2 percent for pressure and 4 percent for flow. The utility has operated it since 2009 and reports cutting non-revenue water by more than 30 percent, maintenance costs by 20 percent and energy use in treatment by 15 percent. The white paper is a downloadable PDF; the page is free to read, a form may be needed for the download and no licence is stated. Caveats: it is a vendor case study, results are self-reported and network data are not published. For simulation, it is a documented digital twin application for operations, optimisation and capacity planning of water distribution.
